The Cauldron is a crafting station used to prepare food. It requires a fire source underneath to operate, such as a Campfire or Hearth.

Building[]

Cauldrons can be placed using the Hammer, found under the Crafting tab. A fire does not need to be present to place a Cauldron, only to use/craft with it.

The Cauldron recipe is unlocked only when the player picks up Tin for the first time after smelting it and has a Forge built.

Upgrades[]

Upgrading a Cauldron enables additional crafting recipes. A Cauldron can be upgraded up to level 6 by building the following structures near it:

Recipes[]

Level 1 (base)[]

  • Boar jerky x2 - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  •  Carrot soup
  •  Cooked egg - introduced in Mistlands.
  •  Deer stew - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  •  Minced meat sauce
  • Queen's jam x4

Level 2[]

  •  Black soup - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  •  Serpent stew
  •  Turnip stew
  • Sausages x4
  •  Muckshake - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  •  Onion soup

Level 3[]

  •  Eyescream - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  • Wolf jerky x2 - introduced in Hearth and Home.
  •  Wolf skewer - introduced in Hearth and Home.

Level 4[]

  •  Fish wraps
  •  Blood pudding

Level 5[]

  •  Fiery svinstew - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Mushroom omelette - introduced in Mistlands.
  • Salad x3 - introduced in Mistlands.
  • Seeker aspic x2 - introduced in Mistlands.
  •  Sizzling berry broth - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Spicy marmalade - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Yggdrasil porridge - introduced in Mistlands.

Level 6[]

  •  Marinated greens - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Mashed meat - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Scorching medley - introduced in Ashlands.
  •  Sparkling shroomshake - introduced in Ashlands.

Notes[]

  • Holding down Shift cooks 5 items at a time.
